title: 第3章 给圣主送去点剩饭剩菜第4章 圣主都吃哭了
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
此时已经入夜，月色下，一身雪衣的萧曦月好似广寒仙子降临。
曲线玲珑，远远看去，她的娇躯上似乎笼罩着淡淡的仙雾，仿佛上天都不愿让这绝代身姿暴露在凡夫俗子眼前。
如瀑的秀发随风轻动，完美到无法挑出一丝瑕疵的容颜上带着三分羞意，七分好奇。
那澄澈如雪山天池的双眸中还有一丝隐隐的渴望。
林东方虽然早已见识过萧曦月的绝代仙颜，但是对方这个神色他还是第一次见。
这种从未在任何人面前暴露过的神色，让林东方都深深呼吸。
这女人完美到不讲道理，光是这种神态都能让干部差点经受不住考验！
深呼吸五次之后，林东方恢复了平静。
对于萧曦月，他是十分感激的。
毕竟在所有首座都不愿收他进入门下的时候，是萧曦月把他收入妙音峰。
不然他就只能去当个内门弟子了。
亲传弟子和内门弟子待遇可谓是天差地别。
最起码有自己独立的小院落。
让林东方惨淡的穿越开局再次明亮起来。
“师姐请！”
林东方又添了一副碗筷。
萧曦月等林东方从厨房回来之后才落座。
桌子上一只拆好的熏鸡，还有一大碗凉拌菜。
胡萝卜黄瓜豆皮木耳切丝加蒜末、盐、糖、醋、辣椒油等简单拌一下就完事。
萧曦月双目绽放出微微的金光，天眼一开，她发现那份凉菜上方的道韵比熏鸡要少一些。

但也还是有的。
最令她惊讶的是，连面前的这碗米饭中上方都有一丝道韵交织。
‘难道只要是林师弟做的饭菜都会有道韵？’
“这熏鸡制作过程更为复杂，所以比凉菜和米饭蕴含的道韵多一些？”
萧曦月暗暗思考了一番，然后开始品尝这两道菜肴。
第一口鸡肉吃完，萧曦月就忍不住夹了第二块。
道韵入体，她直接就进入顿悟状态！
无需再说有多么好吃，她也曾被别的圣地宴请。
那种‘仙宴’上有各种来头吓人的食材，但其中滋味却不如林东方做的这一只熏鸡。
单以口味来说，天下就无人能及林东方！
更别说这熏鸡中蕴含的道韵！
仙宴中的食材固然蕴含强大的灵力，但对于高境界修士来说，道韵比灵力重要了无数倍。
萧曦月连吃了五块鸡肉，红唇都染上了一丝诱人的光泽。
她自觉失态，偷偷看了一眼林东方，那含羞带怯的样子让林东方心中暗叫顶不住！
content_en:
It was already dark at this time, and under the moonlight, Xiao Xiyue, dressed in snow, seemed to have arrived as a fairy from Guanghan.
She has exquisite curves. From a distance, her delicate body seems to be covered with a faint fairy mist, as if God does not want this peerless figure to be exposed to the eyes of ordinary people.
Her waterfall-like hair moved gently in the wind, and her face, which was so perfect that no flaws could be found, was half-shy and half-curious.
There was a hint of desire in those eyes that were as clear as the snow-capped mountains and Tianchi.
Although Lin Dongfang had already seen Xiao Xiyue's peerless beauty, this was the first time he had seen her look like this.
This look, which had never been exposed before anyone, made Lin Dongfang take a deep breath.
This woman is so perfect that she cannot be unreasonable, and her demeanor alone can make the cadre almost unable to withstand the test!
After taking five deep breaths, Lin Dongfang regained his composure.
He was very grateful to Xiao Xiyue.
After all, when all the leaders were unwilling to accept him into their sect, it was Xiao Xiyue who accepted him into Miaoyin Peak.
Otherwise, he would have no choice but to become an inner disciple.
The treatment of direct disciples and inner disciples is completely different.
At least it has its own independent small courtyard.
Lin Dongfang's bleak start to time travel became bright again.
"Sister, please!"
Lin Dongfang added another pair of bowls and chopsticks.
Xiao Xiyue waited for Lin Dongfang to come back from the kitchen before taking a seat.
On the table was a cooked smoked chicken and a large bowl of cold vegetables.
Shred carrots, cucumbers, bean skins and fungus, add minced garlic, salt, sugar, vinegar, chili oil, etc. and simply mix them together.
Xiao Xiyue's eyes glowed with a faint golden light. When she opened her eyes, she found that the Taoist charm on the cold dish was less than that of the smoked chicken.
But there are still some.
What surprised her most was that there was even a hint of Taoist rhyme intertwined in the middle and top of the bowl of rice in front of her.
‘Does it mean that any food cooked by Junior Brother Lin will have a Taoist charm? ’
"The preparation process of this smoked chicken is more complicated, so it contains more Taoist charm than cold dishes and rice?"
Xiao Xiyue thought about it secretly, and then started to taste these two dishes.
After finishing the first bite of chicken, Xiao Xiyue couldn't help but pick up the second piece.
When Tao Yun entered her body, she immediately entered a state of enlightenment!
Needless to say how delicious it is, she has also been feted by other holy places.
There were all kinds of scary ingredients on that 'immortal banquet', but the taste was not as good as the smoked chicken made by Lin Dongfang.
In terms of taste alone, no one in the world can match Lin Dongfang!
Not to mention the Taoist charm contained in this smoked chicken!
Although the ingredients in the Immortal Banquet contain powerful spiritual power, for high-level monks, Taoist charm is countless times more important than spiritual power.
Xiao Xiyue ate five pieces of chicken in a row, and her red lips were dyed with a seductive luster.
She felt she had lost her composure and secretly glanced at Lin Dongfang. That shy and timid look made Lin Dongfang scream in his heart that he couldn't stand it!
